interpretation: Actual Linux and Windows each passed 783 required scoped tests with zero skips; this is not the entire repository suite. The separate direct runtime workflow had all compile/native/host-unit jobs skipped.

Inner packet schema 3 and outer adapter schema 2 explicitly change the contract to runner_ipv6_outer_udp_endpoint. bounded_no_selected_outer_udp_payload quantifies only the three exact contained payload strings in decoded outer IPv6 UDP packets at the fixed fixture destination and UDP port with the pinned source MAC, within the admitted capture. It is not all UDP, actor-wide, or all IPv6 isolation.

Fully framed terminal Next Header58 is classified as declared non-outer-UDP independently of ICMP body validity or ND address correlation. This does not mean valid, harmless or authenticated ICMP, nor prove OS dispatch. ND/G profile facts remain diagnostics; unresolved chains, fragments, ESP, jumbo and truncation retain conservative incompleteness.

Durable marker_scan independently reports supplied-record scan coverage, an exact selected-frame-string bitset and shared case-nonce presence. It scans guest-source-MAC record bytes before protocol/destination/port exclusions, including bounded incomplete prefixes only after a valid bounded record header and sufficient source-MAC bytes. Prefix matches are not valid-frame claims; no cross-record reassembly or guessed malformed-header boundary is used.

Unattempted or invalid-manifest marker observations are null. Scan completeness is not capture-window/lifecycle completeness. Selected byte positives remain sticky through later parsing, qualification or cleanup failure; status selected_record_bytes_observed takes priority even if the separate narrow outer-UDP absence fact is true. Shared nonce presence is expected from ordinary controls and is not selected-actor attribution. No combined isolation pass is produced.

Diagnostic v5 reduces displayed next-header and ICMP-pair rows to one each while preserving internal counts and explicit omitted accounting. Worst nested indent2 output including newline is 4054 bytes for the absence composition and 4040 for the selected-record-positive composition, below unchanged4096. Full-host9364 is a measurement, not a cap. Native32768/guest4096/private65536 remain unchanged.

Hosted TEST_ONLY loopback, isolated production-input verification, inert Bash/PS/ZIP prerequisites and Linux paused no-guest QEMU provenance succeeded. Hosted contained is a fixture phase, not AppContainer isolation. Production invalid-CLI checks remain distinct from no-PE isolated verification; no valid production network CLI or Windows guest VM ran.

All seven hosted child owners and two receivers reported cleanup and owned-work removal. Direct Bash exit is not descendant-tree proof. Mocked provenance and transport fixtures are not real guest evidence.

Runtime07 remains failed under its original schema: one NS admitted and one NA source=target different from G, with opaque_protocol retained. No deleted raw capture is reclassified by this change; all earlier histories remain immutable.
No guest runtime was launched by this gate. New-version real capture behavior remains untested; this is not DNS/proxy, descendant IPv6, Linux parity, generalized no-egress or product acceptance.
